extra_quotes: We evaluate HETEROVLM on an AMD Versal VC1902 (Vitis 2022.1, TAPA [30]) at 240 MHz in the PL and 1.25 GHz in the AIE.

We serve LFM2.5-VL-3B with the integer arithmetic of Section III-E on four kinds of requests: ➊ a 177-token camera question (one 512×288 image: 144 image and 33 text tokens), ➋ a 60-token text question, ➌ a 555-token three-image question (three 512×288 images: 432 image and 123 text tokens) and ➍ a 4,088-token text question.
Decode follows the DDR bandwidth of the VC1902, so Versal AIE SoCs with HBM and AIE-ML tiles would raise the decode rate and attention throughput.
Each bitstream serves one shape class, and the same flow builds a new bitstream from the descriptor of any model outside that class, such as a larger model or one with another layer type.
